decisions.story_title: Microsoft Teams Help Desk Impersonation Social Engineering Campaign
decisions.reason: Active social engineering campaign: attackers open Teams chats from rogue tenants using IT Service Desk display names, trick users into installing MSI payloads or granting remote sessions. Expel documented a fake Windows lock screen capturing passwords. Real, actionable threat.
